sources.description: The Baltimore Ravens won a thrilling matchup against the Dallas Cowboys in Week 3, emerging victorious from a high-scoring affair by three points. A game-winning field goal lifted the Ravens to a 34-31 advantage following some heroics in all three phases. Here are report card grades for each position group from the miraculous win.
